models.rideReport: The full report for a planned bike ride, containing route info and a day-by-day breakdown.
models.dayForecast: Weather data and recommendations for a single riding day.
models.weatherData: Detailed weather data including temperature, wind, precipitation, humidity, UV index, and sun times.
models.clothingItem: A single recommended clothing item with icon, reason, and optional swap alternatives.
models.clothingAlternative: An alternative clothing option the user can swap to.
models.equipmentItem: A recommended piece of equipment with a reason.

relationships: RideReport contains an array of DayForecasts (1 per day)
Each DayForecast has exactly one WeatherData
Each DayForecast has multiple ClothingItems (individual clothing pieces)
Each ClothingItem can have Alternatives for swapping
